formal_population.excluded_population_statement: 4I3V Exact8 remains EXCLUDE_FROM_TRAINING_ONLY; 4I3W/G3H has no sample admission basis in this scope; neither is evaluated as a target.

rule_definitions.owner_or_scope: inactive adapter, ingestion, B1, metadata, formal split
rule_definitions.statement: All consumed owners and snapshots must retain fixed identities.
The four populations must agree exactly; group membership alone is insufficient.
An event must be explicitly INCLUDE and not human-excluded.
The event must belong to the one authoritative train group; reservation stays non-admission.

rule_definitions.owner_or_scope: sample effective supervision and validated B1
rule_definitions.statement: The explicit POA C2 to protein CYS SG event identity must be authoritative.
Element channels and all source/local/flat mappings must remain coherent.

rule_definitions.owner_or_scope: role-mask owner through validated inactive adapter
rule_definitions.statement: Exactly the canonical five long-name tasks are evaluated with B3 retained.
The actual validated candidate domain may support scoped pair and contrastive eligibility without activating a loss.

rule_definitions.owner_or_scope: Task C seed ingestion through inactive adapter
rule_definitions.statement: The approved seed is required only for Task C and does not make seed atoms fixed nodes.
Observed complex C2-SG distance is evidence/input metadata, never PRE/POST training target authority.
Missing PRE/POST geometry is allowed only because geometry is excluded from this scope.
Candidate eligibility must not mutate admission or loss activation.

semantic_projection.scope_statement: Current 4I3U Exact8, published-source-bound, canonical-five non-geometry data-use eligibility only; not formal admission or runtime acceptance.
